source: ClassPad.net Math - exact fx-880BTG PLUS, observed 2026-11-19 through visible keys and LCD SVG; saved directly to project.
notes: Expected full LCD pixels and status flags were observed on the exact fx-880BTG PLUS in ClassPad, 19 November 2026; JSON saved directly into the project. All 35 observations accepted without masks or referenceOnly exclusions.
Observed empty/index/argument/result screens for cube roots and cube roots in exponents, ordinary and small mixed fractions, negative fraction exponents and negative nested powers.

Perfect rational powers retain exact fractions on PLUS: root(-3,8)=1/2, root(3,1/8)=1/2, 4^(-1/2)=1/2, 8^(-1/3)=1/2, root(4,1/16)=1/2, root(-4,81)=1/3, root(5,32/243)=2/3, 8^(-2/3)=1/4. These are observed calculator outputs, not independent mathematical replacements.

Exact roots are found from numerator and denominator with bounded integer search, then raised to the integer numerator of the reduced exponent. Only PLUS number/associative profiles enable this path; legacy 580 profiles stay unchanged. Non-perfect roots continue through the existing numerical path.

Small mixed fractions reserve the same two leading pixels as normal mixed fractions. Root indices of different heights keep their bottom five pixels below the radical top; measured while editing index 1/2, entering argument 9 and showing result 81.
FORMAT on root(5,32/243) changes 2/3 to 0.6666666667 and back to 2/3. Ans times 3 then gives 2. Positive irrational cube root of 2 remains 1.25992105.

Independent tall bases: (1/2)^2=1/4 and (sqrt(2))^3=2sqrt(2), with full pixels confirming the exponent alignment from beta.64. Mixed exponent 2^(1+1/2)=2.828427125 and nested negative exponent 2^(3^(-2))=1.080059739.
